answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 40493 Country: India Title: One person in the state of janabah, awakens from sleeping for Fajr prayer but 10 or 15 minutes are remaining for sunrise Question: One person in the state of janabah, awakens from sleeping for Fajr prayer but 10 or 15 minutes are remaining for sunrise. In this situation is it allowed to wash the najis and private parts and make wudhu and complete the Fajr salah? Answer ID: 40493 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1610/1246/B=1433) No, he will have to offer Fajr salah after making ghusl and being tahir (clean/pure) completely though Fajr salah is missed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
